primary_reference.assumption: formal baseline min(observed,44), not observed contracted hours

transition.wedge_change: tau_cap=(1-relief)*tau; pi, gamma, NF_init, omega and baseline output unchanged
transition.normalization: baseline tau>=0, pi>=0, tau*pi=0; not separate identification
transition.bridge: hourly target fixed; omega and baseline costs recalibrated at each sigma
transition.intervention: conditional static national private formalization cost; not identified fiscal policy
transition.thresholds_method: direct root of Y(A=1+target_pct/100,H,r)/Y0-1 on feasible [0,r_min]
transition.minimum_method: gross-product CES maximum and private FOC; central bounded-optimizer crosscheck

welfare_threshold.composition: reoptimized at every TFP evaluation, including root search
welfare_threshold.calibration: baseline bridge, wedges and preferences held fixed along each curve
welfare_threshold.CE_in_csv: 100*(G1-G0)/C0; same zero as GHH, different denominator
welfare_threshold.resource_constraint: C + resource_cost = Y; input-selected transfer treatment

interpretation.primary: formal habitual hours explicitly capped44 in baseline, with recalibrated hourly bridge
interpretation.alternative: full observed habitual distribution retained as an explicit sensitivity
interpretation.counterfactual: habitual-hours cap proxy, not observed contracted hours
